letters.title: Hi Pooks!
content: Pedro my love,

I've been trying to figure out a way to keep giving you letters for the time being when I can't send them to you the way I originally planned. And so here we are. I'll keep all the handwritten letters safe and sound until I have the chance to give them to you.

For now, though, I'll type them out for you here on occasion so you can still read them more or less around the time I wrote them. I've been working on this since the start of my winter break, and the whole time I was kind of dying to show you. I had to learn how to code from scratch so I could make this perfect. It's taken endless amounts of videos, help from friends, and getting quite frustrated,but it's still not there yet. I might make tweaks occasionally as my coding improves too. But for now, it'll do what it's intended for.

Regardless, pooks, I just wanted to tell you some important things: You've become the best part of my day. You mean the world to me, and I really wanted to find a way to show you how important you are. I know I'm not always great with words, but here I'll have time to think of what to say, so hopefully you'll understand just how much I care about you. I know I always joke that I'm this strong, independent woman, and truth be told, I think I am to some extent. I can stand on my own, and I don't mind being alone, but I don't want to be. I want to spend my life with you.

You've become the best thing about waking up in the morning and the person I dream of at night. You're my best friend, the one person I wanna tell everything to and the first person I want to call whenever I get news, both good or bad. You make my heart happy. I love you, Pedro, and I can't wait to spend the rest of my life with you.

letters.title: I miss you.
content: Pedro my love,

Truth be told, I always thought long-distance was such a stupid thing to do. It’s like punishing yourself for loving someone. And I still think it’s the worst punishment you can make someone endure. Some days, it feels especially heavy.

The past few days have been a little bit hard. Not just because of everything that has happened, but because I’ve never wanted you here with me as much as I did when I was sitting in the doctor’s office alone. It sounds silly, and maybe a bit selfish, but I just really wanted to have your hand to hold. I wanted you beside me.

And I think going through tough things nowadays really makes me notice just how much I value you. Because even when you can’t physically be here, you’re always there in every other way. You help carry the mental load. You listen, you check in, you make things feel a little less overwhelming. You already take such good care of me, and I honestly don’t know what I would do without you.
Pooks, you make me feel so incredibly loved. I wish you knew how much you mean to me.
And maybe that’s why, while I was waiting for you to get home the other night, missing you like I always do, I found myself thinking about us and about how certain I feel that we’ll be okay.

I know you’re not the religious type, but I was reading my Bible while I waited for you, and I came across this verse: Truly I tell you that if two of you agree on anything you ask for, it will be done by my Father in heaven. Matthew 18:19.

And, well, Pooks, I know you’re the love of my life, and I’ve heard you say the same thing to me. So I have faith in us. I have faith that, no matter how difficult this distance feels sometimes, you and I will get through it. And one day, all of this missing each other will just be something we look back on.
Because I really do believe that you and I are going to build a wonderful little life together.

And maybe that’s one of the things I love most about you. It isn’t only the big things. There are so many small things about you that I’ve noticed recently, little things that remind me just how deeply you love me.

Sometimes your love is loud and wonderful, like when you make me laugh, pull silly faces for the camera, or randomly tell me how much you love me. Other times, though, you carry the weight in ways I sometimes miss. Like when you call me even after you’ve had the longest day, or when you check in on me when I get quiet.
Those things might seem small, but they really aren’t.
You make me feel wanted. You make me feel safe. You make me feel loved, even from so far away.
And I’m sorry if I don’t always recognize everything you do for me, love. I hope you know that I notice more than I probably say. You do all these small things that actually aren’t small at all.

I miss you terribly, Pooks. But more than that, I’m grateful for you. And even on the days when I wish more than anything that you were here beside me, I remind myself that being apart doesn’t mean being alone.
I have you. And I’m so lucky that I do.

letters.title: My silly goose.
content: Pedro my love,
I read this quote recently that said, “Anyone can be passionate, but it takes real lovers to be silly.” Naturally, that made me think of you. You are, after all, my silliest goofball.

Sometimes when I tell you I love you, you do this thing where you say, “But why?” And while I know most of the time you’re joking, I thought I’d finally give you a complete answer that you can always come back to.
I love so many things about you that I don’t think I could ever choose a favourite. But I can give you a few of the things I always come back to.

First off, your presence. It sounds a bit dumb to say it so simply, but you’re literally always there when I need you. Sometimes it’s a bit freaky because I’ll look at my phone when you haven’t replied for a while, and as soon as I do, the notification pops up. It’s like you know when my mind starts wandering. You always make time for me, no matter how busy things get or how tired you are.

Second, you try to remember the important things. There are these random little things I’ll tell you, and somehow, months later, when I bring up the same thing, you remember them. You have no idea how happy that makes me. It’s silly, but being the youngest, my opinions are often overlooked, but you never make me feel that way. You always make me feel heard, and the fact that you remember the things I say makes me feel so valued.

You’re so patient. I often joke and say you have the patience of a saint, but it really does seem like you do. I say dumb stuff all the time, I repeat silly mistakes, and I take a long time to learn very simple things. And though you might get annoyed from time to time, you never make me feel like a burden for it. You’re honest with me about things without hurting my feelings, but most of all, you don’t treat me like I’m made of glass. If I’m being obnoxious or hurtful, you’ll tell me.

Your laugh might be my favourite sound. Of all the things I love about you—and there are more than could ever fit on this list—your laugh might be the thing that makes my heart the happiest. Whether it’s while we’re hanging out with your friends or because you’ve seen a dumb video on Instagram, your laugh fills me with so much joy. You always make other people laugh, and I’m always so proud whenever I manage to say something stupid enough to wrangle a giggle or two out of you. I hope I get to spend the rest of my life listening to it.

The best thing I can ask for is that, regardless of what’s happening in your head or in mine, I hope you know my love for you won’t change. I want to do everything with you. I want to spend hours on weekends playing your favourite games and watching your favourite shows. I want to learn how to cook your favourite food for you, eat with you, and go on walks with you. I want to watch you get ready for bed, see which sock you put on first (personally, I always do the left one first), until your routine is second nature to me. I want to know how to read you when you’re happy, annoyed, frustrated, angry, sad, and everything in between. I want to know how to make your bad days better. I want to be the person you come to when you’re tired and need rest. I want to know how to make you feel loved.

Some nights when we call, I look at you and I’m filled with this completely overwhelming sense of gratitude. You listen when I overthink and silence the silly voices that pop up and convince me of things that aren’t true. Thank you for loving me on the days when it feels easy, but especially, thank you for loving me on the days when I know it’s not.
And if I ever forget to say it out loud, you matter to me. You make me better in every way. Thank you, Bubs. For now, when my arms can’t hug you, I hope my prayers always do.
Also, at the time of writing this, I haven't seen you without your beard, but i'll love you regardless. <3

letters.title: Missing you, but with a view.
content: Pedro, my love,

It's been a while since I've written you anything. I got back from my trip today, and all I want to do is spend time with you. I've learned so much over the past few days, not only about my studies, but about my relationship with you. Not being able to send you a message randomly throughout the day affected me more than I thought it would, to be honest. It made me realise just how much I take for granted. I can't tell you how much I missed you randomly calling me during the day, or sending me a message to check in on me.

Getting to tell people about you and how much you mean to me was honestly one of the best parts of my trip. You treat me so well. You're always gentle, loving, and kind. You know when to make jokes to cheer me up and when to be soft and let me cry. I couldn't possibly ask for a better person to have beside me.

Lying in bed every night, the last thing I always thought about was you. I made so many little notes on my phone about all the things I learned or saw during the day that I wanted to share with you. I never did because I felt a bit silly, but I just want you to know that I thought of you. I prayed for you.

There are so many silly little things I'm excited to do with you when I finally get to see you. I can't wait to go on walks with you and watch how your eyes change in the sunlight. I can't wait to hold hands in the grocery store and listen to you talk about the things you love while I'm in the kitchen cooking. I can't wait to hear your voice without it being muffled by a speaker or headphones. I can't wait to make silly kissy faces at you and have it actually end in us kissing. I can't wait to hold you in my arms and tell you how much I love you. I can't wait to walk into a room and know I'm home simply because you're there. You're my world, bubs.

Truthfully, I've been so nervous for you over the past few days about the new job. I know you're nervous too, but I have every confidence in you, your abilities, and your character. I might not know very much about what it entails, but I know there's no one more deserving of the opportunity to grow, learn, and build than you, my love. Though I will miss your laughing during your 12am shifts and the silly faces you make just before someone walks in, I know that this opportunity will lead to a better future. I just want you to know that even though I might not always understand, I'll always be here to listen and support you.

It's a funny feeling knowing that no matter how busy you are or how hectic things get, you'll always have five minutes for me if I need you. Thinking about just how much you love me and how much you care for me almost makes me feel like I could cry, to be completely honest. (I won't, because I know when I cry you get frustrated—not because you're angry, but because you don't know what to do.)

I am not easy to love, and I know you disagree. I don't mean that I'm not worthy of love. I mean that I'll never be the girl who's completely okay with not talking the whole day. I need reassurance often. I overthink, and sometimes the thoughts in my head are louder than the truth. But you never make me feel like I'm too much, and you have no idea what an impact that has had on how I see myself. Pedro, I can't thank you enough for meeting me where I am and walking with me through things instead of leaving me to figure them out on my own.

Thank you for loving me in the best way you know how. Thank you for being patient with me, for being gentle with me, and for being kind to me. Thank you for loving me when I feel like I don't deserve it. Thank you for being my best friend <3.

letters.title: NEW: Recently.
content: Pedro my love,

You are the love of my life. No man has ever treated me as well as you do, loved me as you do, or understood, supported, and comforted me the way you do. I would go through every bad experience a million times over if it meant I would have you waiting for me on the other side.

I know there is still time, and there are still many obstacles between where we are now and the life we hope to build together. But I also know that you are worth all of it. You, my love, are everything I have been hoping for, everything I have been praying for, and more than I could have ever imagined deserving. I am constantly amazed by how deeply you care for me, how gently you speak to me, and how much effort you put into making sure I feel secure, loved, and admired.

Sometimes I get so caught up in overthinking about whether or not I'm doing enough for you, I forget to actually take a step back and tell you how much I appreciate what you do. I am sorry for all the times I fail to recognise how you are feeling. I am sorry for the nights you have spent comforting me when you also needed to be comforted. I am sorry that there have been moments when you have had to help me heal parts of myself that you never had a hand in hurting. I hope you know that I am working every day to become the best possible girlfriend, and eventually the best possible wife, that I can be for you. You deserve to be loved with the same patience, tenderness, and devotion that you give to me.

Sometimes I am overwhelmed by just how much you mean to me. There is this heaviness in my chest that reminds me just how precious you are to me, and how deeply I want to make sure you always feel valued, appreciated, and loved the way you make me feel. I know I will spend the rest of our lives learning how to love you better, growing alongside you, and working on every part of myself that could become better for us.

I am not a perfect person, and neither are you. We will both make mistakes, misunderstand each other, and have moments when loving each other takes work. But I think there is something beautiful in knowing that perfection was never what we needed. Somehow, in all our imperfections, we fit together perfectly when it comes to loving each other.
És o amor da minha vida. Top 10 phrase I learned recently btw.

letters.title: NEW: Meu amor.
content: Pedro meu amor,
Estou a aprender devagar. And feels like it's taking forever.

Truth be told, I feel a little frustrated with myself for not knowing more by now. I had hoped that, at this point, I would at least be able to say silly little things to you and your friends without having to think so hard about every word. Sometimes, when I’m spending time with all of you, I feel a bit stupid. I want nothing more than to be part of the conversation, to laugh along and add something of my own, but there’s still so much I don’t understand. I know you’ll tell me that it’s okay and that I’ll get there eventually, but sometimes I just wish I were already at the point where I didn’t have to sit quietly and listen. I want to be able to joke with you and your friends. I want to understand the little jokes and comments that you make without having to look at you and wonder what I missed. I want to feel like I’m part of it.

Sometimes I feel a little sad that I can’t be as close to all of you as I’d like to be, and I think not being able to communicate on the same level plays a big part in that. It’s difficult to explain because I know this feeling is temporary. I know I’m learning, and I know that one day I’ll be able to speak and understand so much more. But knowing that doesn’t necessarily make it easier right now. It’s hard to admit that sometimes I feel like I’m standing just outside of something I really want to be part of.

And now, as the end of the year gets closer, I’m becoming more aware of the fact that I’ll be moving in just over a year. I think that’s making all of these feelings a little more real. Pooks, I’m scared of feeling like an outsider when I move there if I can’t speak well enough. I’m scared of always needing you to translate or explain things for me, and of feeling like I’m depending on you for something I wish I could do for myself. I know you’ll tell me that I won't burden you, and I know you mean that. I just really want to be able to stand beside you and feel like I belong there too.

I'm sorry if it feels like I'm just complaining. I don't feel like theres anything wrong, and I don't want you to read this and think that I’m unhappy. If anything, I think I’m just frustrated with myself because I want so badly to be further along than I am. I want to be able to communicate with the people you love, not because I feel like you’re asking me to, but because I genuinely want to know them and be a part of your world.And I am hopeful. I really am. I know that I’m learning, and I know that if I keep going, I’ll get better. I think that’s almost what makes the frustration harder sometimes — because I know I’ll get there eventually, I just wish eventually could be now.

I think underneath all of this, I’m just scared. I’m scared of moving somewhere new and not knowing how to express myself properly. I’m scared of being the person who doesn’t understand what everyone is saying, or who has to ask you what something means, or who sits quietly because I don’t know how to join in. I don't expect you to fix that for me, Pooks. I don't need you to reassure me that everything will magically be okay every time I feel like this. I think I just need you to understand that sometimes I get frightened by how much there is still to learn and how little time I feel like I have. I’m going to keep trying, though. I’m not giving up. I just wanted you to know what’s been going through my head, because I love the idea of being part of your world so much that sometimes the thought of not being able to do that scares me.

I mean, I'm supposed to be a safe place you come home to at some point, and I know how frustrating it is not being able to speak your mind comfortably. I want to do everything I can to make things easier for you. Thank you for being so patient with me, in every way.

letters.title: NEW: I want to love you better.
content: Pedro, my love..

You have been such a blessing in my life. You've taught me so much about love, trust and vulnerability. There are points where words like I love you feel so small compared to the depth of whatb I feel for you, but it's all I can do for now. You're so good at making me feel so loved, it becomes almost unfair. I pray constantly that I'll learn how to love you better.

I'm short tempered and I overthink things a lot and sometimes I can be a bit of a mess. And I've recently realized just how much this affects you too. I think sometimes I get so caught up in what I'm feeling that I forget that you have feelings on the other side of it too. When I'm upset or overwhelmed, it doesn't just exist inside my own little world. It can spill over onto you, and I don't ever want the person I love most to feel like he has to carry the weight of emotions that I haven't learned how to handle properly yet.

I don't want to become less emotional or stop caring so deeply about things. I don't want to change the parts of myself that make me me. But I do want to learn how to handle those parts of myself better. I want to learn when I need reassurance and when I'm letting my thoughts run away from me. I want to learn how to communicate when something is bothering me without making you feel like you've done something wrong. I want to be able to tell you that I'm struggling without making you responsible for fixing it. I think loving someone properly means being willing to look at yourself honestly. Not because you're constantly doing something wrong, but because the person you love deserves the effort of you trying to grow. And I want to make that effort for you.

You've been so patient with me in ways that I don't think I always acknowledge enough. You've met me with kindness when I probably haven't made it particularly easy. You've reassured me when my thoughts have gotten the better of me, listened when I needed to talk, and stayed gentle with me even when I was struggling to be gentle with myself. I want to love you in a way that makes you feel safe too. I want you to know that you can have bad days, be frustrated, need space, or simply not have the right words sometimes, and that I will still be here. I want to listen to you as carefully as you've listened to me. I want to understand what makes you feel loved, not just assume that the way I want to be loved is the way you need to be loved.

I think that's what I mean when I say I want to love you better. Not more, because I don't know if I could possibly love you more than I already do. Just better. More thoughtfully. More patiently. More intentionally. I mean, how can I honestly say you mean the world to me if I don't make the effort to love you in a way that makes you feel like you do?.
